# George Osei — Technical Advisor

- **Relationship:** external advisor to Maya; former CTO of a public infrastructure company,
  now an operator-investor. Informal but influential sounding board.
- **Cadence:** monthly dinner or call; on-call for big architecture and org decisions.
- **Where he helps:** platform strategy (has done a monolith-to-platform migration at scale),
  executive hiring, and board dynamics. A quiet Falcon confidant — Daniel approved looping him
  in on the technical thesis only, under NDA.

## How to work with him
- Great for pressure-testing big bets before they go to Daniel or the board.
- He pushes Maya to kill scope and sequence bets; use him before the Q3 board review.
- Keep asks concrete — he gives sharper advice on a specific decision than an open-ended vent.
